purpose: Identify the first exact source ScanIntervals CrossedScan in the original single long rejected capture; do not alter or replay it.

parameters.SOURCE_ROOT: Verified current source checkout; not a user-computer environment.
parameters.HISTORY: Original long framing-sealed temporary file; not strict-admitted history.
parameters.OUTPUT: Fresh local-only inspection report; sanitized summary is a distinct later artifact.

preconditions: Source tree and script size/hash verified; ordinary Python, no -O or PYTHONOPTIMIZE.
Original file size/SHA verified before and after; source remains clean.
Independent static review before publication and execution; no native process still running.
oracle: Exact header, per-frame and trailer hash/count validation on pinned wire3 file.
INPUT coordinates and actual occurrence ordering establish intervals; reference predicates only decorate diagnostic evidence.
Mirror source ScanIntervals first strict failure and distinguish original-policy rejection from explicit post-error diagnostic continuation.
Emit precise before/after occurrence, role, site, slot/generation and independently decoded recorded comparison for the first conflict.
Nonzero exit/capacity/timeout is an inspection failure, not a source explanation; preserve it without rerun or bound growth.
non_claims: Not full semantic admission or replay, nor authority to modify strict policy.
No assertion of an original atomic reads-from order from enclosing brackets.
No source changes, native execution, rebuilt ELF, new capture or repeated timing experiment.
No raw tape/log/binary/local paths published. Only script/plan and separate sanitized result may be committed.
